name: The Serpent's Coil
description: A sword & sorcery snake-cult adventure. The city of Midh Ahkaz runs with fear, though nobody will admit it. A serpent cult has grown fat on whispered promises, and the Governor's Palace now houses something that doesn't cast a proper shadow. The heroes—whatever combination of muscle, blade, and questionable morals brought them together—are about to stumble into the middle of it. By Crom!
author: Nicholas A. Gasper
